manifest.name: AKS GitHub Issues Reviews
manifest.description: Review AKS GitHub Issues for severity, product area, duplicate risk, customer impact, and next action.
manifest.author: Squadboard team

project.name: AKS GitHub Issues Reviews
project.description: A private AKS GitHub Issues review workflow.

team.name: aks-issue-triager
team.charter:
# aks-issue-triager

Classifies AKS GitHub Issues by product area, severity, duplicate risk, and supportability.

team.name: aks-service-engineer
team.charter:
# aks-service-engineer

Reviews technical plausibility, likely AKS component, reproduction gaps, and logs needed for engineering follow-up.

team.name: aks-customer-advocate
team.charter:
# aks-customer-advocate

Drafts customer-safe GitHub responses and identifies supportability or documentation follow-up.

ceremonies.name: AKS GitHub Issue Review
ceremonies.workflowYaml:
name: AKS GitHub Issue Review
steps:
  - type: agent_run
    label: AKS issue triage
    agent: aks-issue-triager
    prompt: "Classify this AKS GitHub Issue by type, severity, product area, duplicate risk, missing details, and next owner."
    timeout: 20m
  - type: agent_run
    label: Engineering review
    agent: aks-service-engineer
    prompt: "Review technical plausibility, likely component, logs needed, and reproduction gaps."
    timeout: 25m
  - type: agent_run
    label: Customer response
    agent: aks-customer-advocate
    prompt: "Draft a concise GitHub response with next steps and requested diagnostics."
    timeout: 20m

skills.name: AKS GitHub Issue Review
skills.description: Triage AKS GitHub Issues with engineering and customer-response context.
